fusions.name: Basking Blow
fusions.desc: A slow, heavy strike that deals 12 damage, makes the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a bolt of cold into the first enemy it meets, dealing 7 damage, with a 40% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds, and 50% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Sloughed Hide
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and restores 10 health to you.

fusions.name: Basking Hide
fusions.desc: During the day, your armour rises by 12%.
